structured_output.what_is_happening: summonPYRO (PYRO) launched on a Meteora dynamic bonding curve (Meteora virtual curve) about 7 hours before detection. It graduated to a Meteora pool about 40 minutes before detection and rose roughly 500% in the hour after graduation, reaching about $160k market cap on $88k volume, with liquidity around $33k. At detection, the last 5 minutes showed more sellers than buyers (73 sells vs 45 buys on DexScreener; 36 vs 20 unique sellers vs buyers on GeckoTerminal), and GeckoTerminal's 5-minute price change was only +8.7%, down from +49.7% over 15 minutes. That points to profit-taking just below the $182.6k all-time high. The dev holds nothing and has launched only this token. The token has a website and an X account with no rename history, and no paid DexScreener boosts. GMGN counts 46 bundler wallets, a 57.5% bot/degen share and 8 smart wallets.

narrative.description: 'summonPYRO' reads like a fire- or summoning-themed meme, possibly AI-agent or game flavoured. The packet has no project description. The token has its own website and X handle and a DexScreener profile, which suggests some deliberate branding, but nothing points to an outside catalyst.
narrative.why_spreading: The move looks like the usual post-graduation pump driven by bots and degen traders, not evidence of an outside narrative. Nothing in the packet shows organic social spread.

token_connection.why_this_token: The name 'summonPYRO' plus its own website and X handle, and it is by far the largest PYRO pair. The other PYRO tokens are under $7k market cap.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are three other PYRO tokens: 6KwpEp (about $6.7k market cap, created the same day, some volume), 8h2uxR (old and dead), and 2bRgtn (dead).

authenticity.evidence: For organic interest: no paid boosts or ads, a clean dev with 0% held, no insider networks, about 279 unique buyers in the first hour, and top-10 holders at 27.6%, which is fairly spread out. Against it: 46 bundler-tagged wallets, a 57.5% bot/degen share and 74 fresh wallets, which fits an orchestrated post-graduation push. Selling now dominates the last 5 minutes.
authenticity.uncertainty: There is no X data, so I cannot tell whether real community attention exists. The bundler tags may be ordinary curve-phase bundles and not a coordinated insider group.

structural_risks: 46 bundler wallets could dump into about $33k of liquidity
Selling pressure dominates the last 5 minutes, just below the all-time high
A 2x from entry needs roughly $300k+ market cap on thin liquidity
Price is already up about 500% in an hour, so the move looks exhausted
Only 78% of the LP is locked in the main market (GMGN reports the LP burn ratio as 1.0)

structured_output.counterargument: Meteora graduates with locked LP, a clean dev, no paid promotion, some smart-wallet presence and a real brand (website plus X) can run from $150k to $500k+ in their first hours when a KOL picks them up. Momentum is still strong on the 15- and 30-minute windows, and a dip over the next 25 minutes could give a cheaper entry that makes the 2x reachable.
unknowns: Price at entry, 25 minutes after detection
Whether the X account has real engagement or KOL coverage
Whether the bundler wallets still hold supply

source_coverage.notes: Offline condition: judged only from the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is a post-graduation Meteora pump, up about 500% in an hour, with bundler- and bot-heavy flow. The latest 5 minutes show sellers outnumbering buyers just under the all-time high. The structure is cleaner than most tokens in this pool (clean dev, locked LP, no paid promotion), so an outright LP pull is less likely. Still, doubling again from roughly $150k with no visible narrative catalyst is unlikely. The most likely path is a bleed or a -50% move.
